MUMBYE: MAXIMUM CITY - CONTROLS & GUIDE

🚶 ON FOOT

  • WASD / Arrows: Move Kabir
  • Shift: Sprint
  • Space: Jump
  • Left Click / F: Attack / Fire Weapon
  • Right Click: Aim Crosshair (Over Shoulder)
  • 1 - 6 / Q / Wheel: Change Weapon
  • E: Enter Vehicle / Eat Vada Pav at Tapri

🛺 VEHICLES

  • W / Up: Accelerate
  • S / Down: Brake / Reverse
  • A / D: Steer
  • Spacebar: Handbrake & Drift
  • Shift: Nitro Boost (Bandra DLC)
  • H: Mumbai Horn / Police Siren
  • R: Switch Mumbai Radio Station
  • T: Toggle Taxi Driver Missions
  • E: Exit Vehicle

📱 PHONE & DLC

  • P: Open Bambaiya Smartphone
  • M: Open DLC & Mod Manager
  • B: Bhai Time (Slow-Mo Bullet Time)
  • Tapri: Restores 100 HP for ₹20
  • Enforcement: Clear heat via legal phone bond
  • ESC: Pause Menu & City Map

🛸 DRONE & FLIGHT

  • U: Deploy / Recall SkyEye Drone
  • Space / Shift: Altitude Climb / Descend
  • WASD: Fly Drone / Helicopter
  • Left Click: Fire Drone EMP Taser Dart
  • E: Take Elevator / Board Helicopter
